name: Koneko to Kazoku Keikaku
source:
You've has lost his parents at a young age.
As you are feeling depressed, a cat-eared girl approaches you.

"I will take care of you nya! I'm returning the favor nya!"

A stray koneko started working as your maid.


When you return home, she rubs up against you.
She hates water and baths, and if you try to force her she goes crazy.
If you try to trim her claws she scratches you covering you in scars.

While living with this koneko, one day a change occurs to her body.
As she begins maturing, the mating season comes, and your lives quickly change---

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE245573.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
你年幼时失去了父母。
感到沮丧时，一名猫耳女孩向你走来。

“喵！让我来照顾你吧！喵！这是我的报恩！”

一只流浪小猫开始担任你的女仆。

你回家时，她会依偎过来。
她讨厌水和洗澡，若你强迫她，就会发疯。
如果你试图给她剪指甲，她会抓伤你，在你身上留下伤痕。

和这只小猫共同生活时，她的身体某天发生了变化。
随着她逐渐成熟，发情期到来，你们的生活迅速改变——
